## Biography

Coordinates: 536.69, -332.13, -1112.69. Independent system. Population: ~289 million. Controlled by Deep Space Surveys under democratic governance. High security. Industrial economy with agricultural secondary. Pristine reserves.

This is where Distant Worlds 3 launched. Where John Ermitage and Cal argued about GalCop technology while a woman in a tech outfit directed cargo with military precision. Where Hermine Delarue recruited Cal over Lavian Brandy. Where Captain Yuen counted down the mass jump that changed everything — "Three. Two. Punch." — and where the witch-space anomaly first appeared at fleet scale.

NGC 1981 Sector ZU-Y d27 is unremarkable on galactic charts. A K-type primary, some rocky worlds, no tourist infrastructure. But on January 22nd, 3312, thousands of nav locks painted faint geometry across its dark, and an armada leaned together into a corridor that was not as empty as it should have been. Some systems are defined by what happens in them. This one is defined by what left it.
